purpose: Mate the exact EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 configured assembly directly to the UI PCB through one serviceable 50-contact ZIF; the enclosure bezel and compliant panel bed carry every mechanical load.

components.role: direct dual-contact 50-position ZIF for the exact 0.30-mm EastRising tail

mechanical_retention.panel_support: continuous front-shell display bed plus bezel overlap outside the active and touch areas
mechanical_retention.primary_retention: thin perimeter display-grade PSA on the front-shell bed
mechanical_retention.secondary_retention: four corner locators and a compliant 0.5-1.0-mm closed-cell rear preload pad
mechanical_retention.flex_strain_relief: controlled folded-tail corridor from the antenna edge to the direct ZIF; no tensile or peel load reaches the contacts or latch
mechanical_retention.service_rule: opening the sandwich exposes the ZIF latch; release the latch before lifting the display assembly

electrical.signal_contract: the UI PCB routes every required panel power, ground, i8080-8, recovery and touch net directly to the exact 50-contact connector; manufacturer NC and SDO contacts remain open
electrical.recovery_mode: deliberate strap change to ILI9488 4-wire serial; no QSPI claim

recovery_straps.primary_population: i8080-8: pin 34 and TE pin 39 are open; pin 38 CS is strapped low; RD is strapped high; IM2/IM1/IM0 = 0/1/1
recovery_straps.serial_recovery: service-only solder-jumper population links panel SDA pin 34 to S3 LCD_DB7/GPIO46 and moves CS pin 38 from ground to S3 LCD_DB6/GPIO42; the mode-select jumpers are repopulated to the manufacturer 4-wire-serial code
recovery_straps.safety: all recovery pads are on the opened inner face and cannot change mode during normal use

electrical.h2_rule: H2 places this connector on the UI PCB and routes the accepted panel map directly; no display adapter PCB or board-to-board display connector is populated.

orientation.panel_rule: mount the configured panel with its folded FPC toward the antenna edge, as on ESP32-DIV, so the tail never enters the LED, navigation or function-key zone
orientation.display_memory_transform: rotate ILI9488 output by 180 degrees relative to its cable-down native orientation
orientation.touch_transform: rotate FT6236 coordinates by 180 degrees before UI hit-testing
orientation.tail_contract: manufacturer drawing controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm-pitch, 0.30-mm-stiffened folded tail; H5 incoming inspection verifies lot conformity and insertion

evidence.finding: EastRising controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm tail, complete CTP outline, 8080-8 strap and every LCD/touch/backlight contact.
Exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 is orderable at quantity one with the ER-TPC035-6 capacitive-touch option.
FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50) is exact HRS original-manufacturer C3169104, Extended SMT, Economic/Standard PCBA, MOQ 1 and verified live stock.

release_boundary: H1 freezes the exact panel, direct C3169104 ZIF position, 50-contact electrical map, folded-tail corridor and non-load-bearing connector rule. H2 imports the exact footprint and routes the display sheet directly on the UI PCB; H5 confirms current-lot tail conformity, written factory acceptance for panel PSA/FPC insertion and one-prototype final mating.
